# ADR-0001: Preserve current flow while adding architecture package

## Status

Accepted

## Context

REQ-001 and ASR-001 require evidence-backed brownfield recovery.

## Decision

Keep current flow and add contract-backed documentation.

## Consequences

- Existing behavior remains the baseline.
- Future changes must update traceability.

## Rejected Alternatives

| Alternative | Reason Rejected |
|---|---|
| Rewrite flow first | Too much compatibility risk. |
